items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy today announced its intent to deploy Defense Production Act (DPA) funding to accelerate the expansion of transmission capacity in Virginia and West Virginia, strengthening grid reliability and infrastructure essential to national defense.

items.title: PJM, ERCOT, and SWPP all set peak load records this summer
items.summary: Three regional transmission organizations (RTOs) set records for peak hourly load this past summer, according to data reported on Form EIA-930 and presented in the Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.

items.title: NERC Examines International Blackouts to Strengthen North American Grid Reliability
items.summary: As electric grids worldwide undergo significant transformation, a new NERC white paper examines three major international blackouts and identifies critical lessons for strengthening the reliability and resilience of North America’s bulk power system.

items.title: Monthly wind generation in ISO-NE is about 68% higher than last year
items.summary: Monthly wind generation in the first nine months of 2026 was an average of 68% higher compared with the same period in 2025 in ISO New England (ISO-NE).

items.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has commissioned Westinghouse to begin ordering long-lead items for the first unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant, which will comprise three AP1000 reactors.

items.title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
items.summary: Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant's unit 7 has been successfully connected to the grid, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

items.title: Last Energy's Texas micro-modular reactor clears safety analysis
items.summary: The Department of Energy's approval of the Documented Safety Analysis clears Last Energy's planned pilot reactor at Texas A&M-RELLIS to move into the readiness review, the final step before authorisation for criticality and reactor operations.

items.title: DOE offers Vistra loan for reactor upgrades and uprates
items.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced a conditional loan commitment of up to USD4.2 billion to finance uprates and modernisation projects at Vistra Corp's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry nuclear power plants.

items.title: NERC Statement on 2026 Cold Weather Performance Review
items.summary: Yesterday, FERC, NERC, and its Regional Entities released a joint staff report reviewing how the bulk power and natural gas systems performed during the winter 2026 arctic cold weather period.

items.summary: Today, at its monthly open meeting, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) approved NERC Reliability Standard CIP-014-4 (Physical Security), which will update protections for electric infrastructure that could be vulnerable to a physical attack.

items.title: FERC, NERC Review Shows Bulk-Power System Improvements in Preparation and Coordination During Winter 2026 Arctic Cold Period
items.summary: FERC, NERC, and its Regional Entities said today that the country’s Bulk-Power System demonstrated strong performance during extreme cold weather events earlier this year, with no significant disruptions in either the natural gas or electric systems.

items.title: EIA expects record electricity generation in 2026 and 2027
items.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) expects U.S. electricity generation will grow 2.2% to a record 4,368 billion kilowatthours (BkWh) this year. EIA expects an additional 1.7% growth in electricity generation next year.
